observations: The closure screws can be tightened until the rigid jaws close, and the tube still does not grip.
The observer reports more compression toward X+ than X−.
source_quotes: Then back to the t-handle, I've got the screws on there, and I can clamp them down all the way still, and I still don't get grip.
but one problem I found, is the screws are not centered on the TPU! And it does not clamp balanced in the X axis, is pressing down more in X+ than it is in X-.

model_inspection.authority: Codex, measured from the identified CAD source

screenshot.scope: View of the current CAD; not a photograph measuring the physical pressure distribution.

scope: Physical grip failure and reported uneven compression. CAD establishes the axial screw offset; it does not establish the pressure distribution or that centering alone resolves grip.
